scope: Movies4-10 only, all encoded frames decoded, nine visual samples per movie. No public source-image adaptations, model/source fit, raw-z reconstruction, segmentation truth or measurement-noise change.

observation_contract_inventory.inspection_method: Codex image tool displayed each retained local contact sheet separately, after full-frame decoding; nine samples include first, selected middle, and last frame. Movie5 last native frame additionally displayed to read its final clock. This is not a claim every frame received human-style visual inspection.
observation_contract_inventory.image_publication: LOCAL_INSPECTION_ONLY. Source images and contact sheets must not be treated as original public scientific figures.
observation_contract_inventory.common_nominal_genotype_from_description: OptoGEF2, two copies RhoGEF2-tgRFPt-SspB and mCh-iLID-CaaX membrane marker except Movie5 labels only specify OptoGEF2 with/without scra RNAi; do not silently infer full copy numbers for Movie5.

shared_observation_contract_result.interpretation: These seven published display movies add seven captioned examples, eight displayed specimen slots because Movie5 compares two embryos; uniqueness across movie files is not established. They do not supply a matched17-record dataset or a complete measurement-workflow crosswalk. No claim that the authors lack such data or that no data exist elsewhere.
partial_metadata_is_present: burned display clocks and scale bars
missing_or_unidentified_in_this_package: mapping of these displayed specimens to the17 calibration columns
full raw3D initial and time-resolved apical/basal surfaces
machine-readable response ROI and measurement masks
source convention aligning spatial/temporal maxima to all four scalar endpoints
not_inferred: dark projected area is a certified void
caption scale/depth is directly calibrated container metadata
same genotype means same source specimen
images establish a material parameter or noise bound

limitations: No fullcohort identity/dose/geometry/reference/ROI/uncertainty crosswalk found in these seven videos and their captions
Visible event clocks are not container playback timestamps
Caption scales/depths are source assertions, not machine acquisition calibration
Visual morphology or author arrow annotation is not an anatomical contour/error certificate
Finite seven-movie coverage is not an assertion of global data absence
